'''Hox Bilan''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. Several of Bilan's employees were tasked with retrieving a [[Data rod/Legends|datastick]] held by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|LE-BO2D9]].
